verdict.rationale: Public GOV.UK guidance says up front that applicants verify identity and submit documents through the UK Immigration: ID Check app, and that founder applications must be made online. That is one identity-proofing step disclosed before filing. Missing for 10: an explicit up-front list of account-creation and credential steps, a complete enumeration of identity-proofing paths (e.g. biometric appointment alternatives), evidence that the founder-route page itself discloses these steps, and hands-on corroboration that nothing new appears mid-flow.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow

citations.quote: verify your identity and submit your documents and application online using the UK Immigration: ID Check app
